features.label: Facial thirds
features.subject: Austin Butler
features.vo: First, your facial thirds. Hairline to brows, brows to nose, nose to chin. When the three are close to equal, the face reads balanced.

features.label: Hair for your face shape
features.chip: volume where your face needs it
features.subject: Timothée Chalamet
features.vo: Second, a haircut that fits your face shape. A long face wants volume at the sides. A round face wants height on top.

features.label: Posture
features.vo: Third, posture. Chin level, shoulders back, neck straight. It shows all the height you already have.

caption: Facial thirds, a haircut for your face shape, and posture. Three checks you can do in the mirror.
notes: SLA-1653: first E reel. Their 3 points minus height (board). Demo faces reuse existing cutouts (Butler, Chalamet), $0 restyle.
